newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese tax revenue rises Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese tax revenue rises Jan-April.

text.p: The Portuguese government's tax revenue totalled 1,155 billion escudos over the first four months of the year compared with an estimated 1,027 billion over the same period of 1996, the Finance Ministry said.
But the numbers are not strictly comparable, the ministry added, as the government's 1996 budget only came into effect in the spring and numbers for the early part of the year are estimates.
Income from direct taxes in the first four months was 407.2 billion escudos against 387.4 billion in 1996. Value added tax (VAT) revenue was up 31 percent at 407 billion.
